quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Matsue's 2022-2029 comprehensive plan, annually revised implementation/KPI route, FY2026 budget, and FY2024 settlement. Municipal KPI attainment remains source-reported and is not converted into independent policy achievement, causal effects, fiscal effectiveness, or cross-city comparison judgments.
